newsitem.title: USA: Perini closes $30 mln equity transaction.
newsitem.headline: Perini closes $30 mln equity transaction.

text.p: Perini Corp said on Friday it closed a previously announced $30 million issuance of a new series B cumulative convertible preferred stock to an investor group led by Richard C. Blum & Associates L.P.
Two proposals allowing the transaction to be completed were passed at a special meeting of shareholders, it said.

Chairman and Chief Executive Officer David Perini said: "We are very grateful to have such strong support from our shareholders -- nearly 70 percent of the outstanding shares voted with nearly 90 percent of the votes cast being in favor of our two proposals."
He said the funds strengthened the company's balance sheet and improved working capital needed to support Perini's growing backlog of construction work.
